decisions.decision: {"id":"tier-b-split","summary":"Option A: breaking IR changes (B3 modifiers, B1 keystroke, B2 typed LHS) move to a follow-on spec; B4 replaced by importer-report policy; prep accessors FR-032..038 land in 116","by":"km-lead ruling, owner accepted 2026-11-10"}
Comment differences on smp-literal lines the new reader types are checked against the legacy stripTrailingComment split of the fragment text, not allow-listed
decisions.why: SC-003 forbids allow-listing comment differences; the comment was inside the legacy fragment sourceText, so equality with the legacy split proves no text changed
the line loop reads both from NEWLINE tokens; records would have no consumer
decisions.rejected: building records per the contract table

decisions.decision: reader-regression reads its expected counts from the committed reader-differential.md
decisions.rejected: duplicating the counts as literals in the test

decisions.decision: producedSet/expandStore stays frozen (spec 063 FR-008/FR-010): a store holding a typed outs item contributes nothing, as its pre-116 outs-expansion fragment did; T055's 'producedSet uses resolveStoreItems' yields to its own same-result rule. typed-members.test pins this.
Capability types are prefixed (CapabilityFormat, CapabilityImportStatus, CapabilityExportStatus)
decisions.why: contracts already exports ImportStatus (the import report); the barrel would clash
decisions.rejected: the contract names Format/ImportStatus/ExportStatus as written

decisions.decision: Node fields are classified row|internal in a satisfies-Record map; only row fields get table rows, RawKmnFragment is one row
decisions.why: nodeId, sourceLine, ownership markers and analysis sketches are not format constructs, and a KMN-mapped cell for them would be meaningless; the map still forces a decision for every new field

decisions.decision: cldr-legacy export cells are n/a with a note rather than absent
decisions.why: the coverage check asks for a cell per format; n/a with a note says input-only explicitly
decisions.rejected: omitting cldr-legacy export cells as the contract sketch says

decisions.decision: buildOutputRepertoire expands typed outs() stores through resolveStoreItems instead of filtering them out
decisions.why: pre-116 those stores were fragments whose storeSketch (the expansion) the repertoire read; filtering left any()/index() over them unresolved and the normalization step refused el_dinka and sil_yoruba8
decisions.rejected: re-attaching a storeSketch to typed stores

decisions.decision: CHANGELOG entry went to packages/contracts/CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased]
